The **STDO Axiomatic Calculus for Governed Symbolic Systems**, written `a_c`,
is STDO's domain-specific, carrier-neutral constitutional calculus for
representing and relating governed symbolic systems.

concepts.definition: Traversal v is a typed contract with id, domain, codomain, context, owner, scope, basis, preconditions, postconditions, authority, evidence, provenance and stop_states. F_K[v](X_v) -> Y_v | Omega_v binds a functor kind, exact traversal identity, typed input/result domains and closed stop refinement. F_D = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-d classifies deterministic evaluation/proof returning a judgment without performing the construction judged. F_P = urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:f-p classifies bounded probabilistic interpretation/construction/proposal. grounding.quote:

  It returns a judgment and does not perform the domain construction being

- `F_P` classifies bounded probabilistic interpretation, construction, or
  proposal under an exact traversal contract. Its result has no semantic,
  admission, acceptance, or closure authority merely because it is useful or
  repeatable.
- `F_H` classifies explicit human adjudication under an exact identity,
  authority grant, subject, basis, and decision contract. Human presence grants
  no ambient authority.

concepts.definition: Design Module Method owns generic design-contract law and an adoptable realization profile. Its purpose is stronger implementation discipline, with biases toward low coupling, modular composition, immutable typed carriers, total or nearly-total semantic transforms and explicit effect boundaries. Goals include reduced ambiguity, entropy, avoidable debt, hidden authority/mutation and semantic drift; increased refactorability; and evidence enabling later audit and reconstruction. It concerns realization design and implementation shape, not language ideology.

grounding.quote: # Design Module Method

- low coupling
- modular composition
- immutable typed carriers
- total or nearly-total semantic transforms
- explicit effect boundaries

concepts.label: Design Module Method

concepts.definition: A governed design boundary is the scoped unit to which selected design relations apply. A material semantic boundary changes identity, authority, lifecycle, public contract, externally observable Product meaning, cross-module topology, or accepted effect/closure law. Module boundaries are one realization-level means of bounded intermediate reasoning, implementation, evaluation, proof and later refactoring; schemas/carrier families, entity/record design and interface contracts are also within the method's scope.

grounding.quote:
Proportionality applies. A **material semantic boundary** is one whose change
affects identity, authority, lifecycle, public contract, externally observable
Product meaning, cross-module topology, or accepted effect or closure law.

concepts.label: Governed design boundary

concepts.definition: Ontology is prior semantic-design authority for an adopted boundary, subordinate to constitutional WHAT. It derives from intent, Product, requirements and applicable graph/domain method and, once accepted, governs entities, relationships, invariants, lifecycle, authority, functions, composition and effects. Its inventory includes entities, identities, relationships, invariants, lifecycle, authority, atomic functions, higher-order composition, effects and projections. Accepted design separately owns structural HOW: topology, interfaces, carrier placement, module boundaries, algorithms and local realization.

grounding.quote:
The Ontology does not replace target architecture or module design. Accepted
design remains the structural `HOW` for topology, interfaces, carrier placement,
module boundaries, algorithms, and local realization. Implementation and tests
derive from requirements plus accepted design and must preserve the accepted
Ontology; they are not direct substitutes for either layer.

A class inventory, schema list, endpoint list, command list, or carrier census
alone is not an Ontology.

concepts.label: Accepted design Ontology

U(B) = unresolved(M(B)). Decision completeness means U(B) is empty, M(B) is jointly satisfiable, and all networks it admits are semantically equivalent under governing Product, requirements and accepted design relations. co_evolution_admissible(B) iff decision_complete(B); design_gate(B) is the smallest causally closed affected set needed to establish it.

concepts.definition: Foundation selection is a proportional, bounded, reproducible, explicitly non-exhaustive comparison of candidate compositions for material generic capabilities, common mechanics, algorithms and dependencies. Candidates may draw on admitted project foundations, language/runtime/platform/standard-library capabilities, accepted predecessor or immutable-lineage evidence, maintained external foundations where dependencies are permitted, and bounded local implementations. The undominated frontier contains lawful materially incomparable candidate compositions.

grounding.quote:
Native constructability proves that the selected substrate can realize the
design. It does not prove that locally constructing another generic mechanism
is the best realization. Before constructing a material generic capability,
common mechanic, or algorithm, or selecting a material dependency, the active
design boundary must perform a proportional foundation-selection pass.

concepts.definition: Atomic function families are the smallest parameterized families making entity lifecycles logically complete. Function-derivation evidence records discovered functionality, entity, atomic function/template, higher-order composition, effect class, required authority and disposition. Higher-order behavior has explicit composition/effect algebra; examples include unit/lift, sequential, parallel/applicative, fold/evaluation, retry/recovery, recursion/fixed point and projection.

grounding.quote:
The Ontology must derive the smallest parameterized atomic function families
that make the entity lifecycles logically complete. Variation that changes only
an entity kind, projection kind, transition kind, policy, or subordinate payload
should normally be a typed parameter or closed variant of one function family,
not another peer function.

concepts.label: Atomic functions and higher-order composition

concepts.definition: A Prime semantic atom is an irreducible design relation: an atomic function family, identity, authority transition, lifecycle relation, topology, effect, closure law or composition law that cannot honestly be composed from other accepted atoms while preserving meaning. Prime is determined at semantic-design altitude. A small, typed, named or independently testable file, function, class, schema, public operation, diagram, module or owner category is not thereby Prime.

grounding.quote:
A **Prime semantic atom** is one irreducible design relation: an atomic function
family, identity, authority transition, lifecycle relation, topology, effect,
closure law, or composition law that cannot be expressed honestly by composing
other accepted atoms while preserving the same meaning.

concepts.label: Prime semantic atom

concepts.definition: Irreducible Architectural Carrier Set (IACS) is the smallest lawful top-level carrier family needed for a boundary's real functionality and authority flow. Subordinate Payload is internal payload detail, not top-level by default. Promotion Test is the explicit test for promoting it to a top-level type. Boundary Inflation is promotion of subordinate detail to extra peer types without irreducible need. Example IACS roles include source truth, admission, execution, yielded/recovery, effect plan and public projection carriers; these examples do not mandate a fixed inventory.

grounding.quote:
- **Irreducible Architectural Carrier Set**: the smallest lawful top-level
  carrier family required for one boundary
- **Subordinate Payload**: payload detail that exists inside that boundary but
  is not top-level by default
- **Promotion Test**: the explicit test a subordinate payload must pass before
  it becomes a top-level type
- **Boundary Inflation**: the defect where subordinate payload detail is
  promoted into extra peer types without irreducible need

The Irreducible Architectural Carrier Set is the smallest set of carriers
required to carry the real functionality and authority flow of the boundary.

constraints.statement: Definitions do not depend on derivation-source layout, selected subject interpretation, carrier, provider, runtime or repository topology. Selected-cut F1–F6 and shared laws are operative premises; predecessor clauses are historical provenance. Signature, record kinds, closure operator and functor classification are this standard's additional owned choices, not uniquely derived from either source or finite capacity. Given explicit interpretation and typed subject, references must be resolved and compatible on one exact basis before consuming a model judgment. AC-007/014 consume the shared result algebra; AC-016 consumes conjunction for claims requiring several judgments. The transformation library supplies reusable responsibilities but neither replaces AC-013 nor establishes categorical functor laws. Universal applicability, completeness, consistency, decidability, soundness and categorical status are not asserted absent the stated proof exception.
constraints.uncertainty: External premises and shared contracts are referenced but not supplied.

The mutable authoring links are not themselves

grounding.quote:
`a_c` does not choose the subject vocabulary, decide which source declarations

constraints.statement: The calculus governs symbolic-model form: identities/types, exact relation endpoints, explicit constraints/latitude/residuals, traversal/judgment typing, closure/projection/overlay/transformation behavior, subject preservation, and separation of structural, semantic and authority claims. It does not choose vocabulary or material declarations, supply semantic acceptance, select a carrier, execute a model or prove unique interpretation.

exceptions: An empty population is allowed only if the selected signature requires no member of its record kind.

grounding.quote:
Every `a_c` signature imports those identities unchanged. A model-family
signature specializes their fields, value domains, reference domains, and
admissible kinds; it does not remove, rename, shadow, or silently add a core
record family. Another fundamental record family requires an explicit
compatible calculus extension rather than an extra subject sort.

constraints.statement: Every signature imports all eight core identities unchanged; specialization closes fields/value domains, identity-reference domains/cardinalities, relation endpoint sorts, constraint subject/predicate domains, residual subject/uncertainty/consequence/re-entry domains, judgment input/output/evidence/stop contracts and permitted traversal kinds. Removing, renaming, shadowing or silently adding core families is prohibited; a new fundamental family requires explicit compatible calculus extension, not a subject sort. Unknown fields/kinds require a new signature or compatible extension relation. Population_M is total, finite and disjoint, with each fundamental record exactly once and globally unique identity. External_M identities require exactly one signature-declared external domain and exact resolution. Hidden records, unpopulated extra families, duplicated identities or identities lacking one lawful local/external resolution refuse the model. Every scalar/collection identity reference is checked by RefDomain_Sigma: exact target population, semantic sort when applicable, or exactly one external target kind/basis relation, never both local and external. Missing domains, wrong family/sort, ambiguity and dangling external identities refuse structural admission.

grounding.quote:
A traversal, transformation, or judgment is not placed in `O` merely by
reifying its name as a semantic object. A subject model may independently
represent the concept of a record kind, but that representation does not
satisfy the core population law.

constraints.statement: SemanticObject, TypedRelation, Constraint, Latitude and Residual populate O/E/C/L/X; traversal/transformation/judgment records populate V/T/J. Independently representing a record-kind concept as an object does not place an operative record in O or satisfy its population obligation.

conditions: A governed symbolic model has a declared signature and interpretation and represents a separately identified subject.

grounding.quote:
These arguments apply [F1–F6](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundational-commitments)
to a governed symbolic model under a declared signature and interpretation.
The model's records represent a separately identified subject; some predicates
admit mechanical decision and others require semantic judgment. These are the
calculus's instance conditions. Its finite signature and record choices do not
follow from an actor's finite capacity. Selection authority remains bound by
[Interpretation And Models](#interpretation-and-models).

constraints.statement: The family arguments are conditional: recoverable referents and typed composition support admission; scoped identity, evidence and grants distinguish identity/authority/basis; constraint evaluation preserves predicate, cause, performance and effects; uncertainty gives neither permission nor disposition authority; task views retain exact dependencies and external seams; producing successors does not admit them; shared executors do not turn proposals into assessment/adjudication; structural validity does not establish fidelity; evidence at one layer does not grant another layer or Product standing. Owners retain concrete sorts/reference domains, identity/composite bases, domain predicates, permitted variation/residual dispositions, seeds/required-edge semantics, equality/loss/grants, topology/operator, material selection/admitted loss, and Product acceptance/release. Closed syntax does not prove semantic adequacy; finite capacity proves neither chosen inventories nor finite unique closure or minimum cost. Calculus policies are additional choices, including total populations, exact bases, cause-sensitive judgments, explicit L/X, least fixed points/Boundary_Z, overlays/deltas, three functor kinds/bracket syntax, source treatment dispositions and separate layer identities.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced shared laws and later external owners are not reconstructed from these arguments.

transformation specialization, and judgment belongs to one declared signature.

shadowed, or unknown record kinds and populations fail closed.

exceptions: Same-name/different-shape carriers may be admitted by explicit migration design.

grounding.quote:
For each changed semantic boundary, bind its authoritative carrier or contract
and every consuming interface under
[Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application).
The change must not increase truth surfaces; seam-closure work reduces existing
rival surfaces. Removing the authoritative carrier must make its consumers fail
closed, rather than reconstructing its meaning from raw artifacts, controller
state or payload fragments. [Ingress Collapse](#3b-ingress-collapse-rule)
governs raw input.

constraints.statement: Bind every changed boundary's authoritative carrier/contract and every consumer under Contract application. Do not increase truth surfaces; seam closure reduces rival surfaces. Removing authoritative carrier must make consumers fail closed instead of reconstructing meaning from raw artifacts, controller state or payload fragments; raw input follows Ingress Collapse. Publication applies Faithful projection to named admitted carrier/runtime/event/source truth. Catalog/ownership/route/status/closure views must structurally compare exposed relation with source before publication. Same-name/different-shape carriers refuse absent migration exception. Negative proof covers structural drift and absent truth.

conditions: The method governs a change.

grounding.quote:
Each change should collapse the slice to the few real identity-bearing carrier
families.

This means:

- declare the Irreducible Architectural Carrier Set first
- keep Subordinate Payloads subordinate by default
- avoid fragment classes, interfaces, or result records created only to satisfy
  typing, serialization, or convenience extraction

constraints.statement: Each change should consolidate to few real identity-bearing families: declare IACS first, keep payloads subordinate by default and avoid fragment classes/interfaces/results made solely for typing, serialization or extraction convenience. Progress means fewer sharper families, less duplicate authority and boundary inflation, not added wrappers, branch-local peer types or public records mirroring payload detail.

conditions: Enforcing a semantic boundary with typing, schemas, validators, contracts or codecs.

grounding.quote:
- parse, validate, or construct first
- admit and narrow the boundary explicitly
- then use types or schemas to enforce the proved shape

It does **not** mean:

- relabel an open payload and call it closed
- wrap loose data in a typed envelope while keeping the same authority path
- use casts, unchecked assertions, or dynamic mutation as fake closure

constraints.statement: First parse/validate/construct; explicitly admit/narrow; then enforce proved shape. Relabeling open payloads, typed envelopes preserving loose authority, casts/unchecked assertions/dynamic mutation do not establish closure. The rule is language-neutral: strict typing, sealed ADT/parser or compiler sum type/decoder are examples of enforcement after proof.

conditions: Foreign, dynamic or weakly typed input enters a governed boundary.

grounding.quote:
Foreign, dynamic, or weakly-typed input is lawful only at ingress.

Once admitted, it must collapse immediately into local carrier truth before
semantic transforms begin.

The required shape is:

1. receive foreign input
2. parse, validate, or normalize it once
3. construct local admitted carrier truth
4. consume only that local truth in semantic kernels

constraints.statement: Such input is lawful only at ingress; immediately after admission and before semantics, parse/validate/normalize once into local admitted carriers and consume only them in kernels. Repeated parsing across modules, from_dict/to_dict round trips preserving open authority, loaders merely relabeling stored maps/JSON and direct kernel inspection of open fragments are not lawful closure.

conditions: The functional-realization profile is adopted.
exceptions: Preference for explicit failure carriers over exception-driven control flow is qualified by 'where practical'.

grounding.quote:
Projects using this method must prefer:

- immutable data carriers over mutable shared objects
- closed typed carriers over open dict or string protocols
- parsing and admitting foreign data once at ingress
- explicit return values over hidden mutation
- explicit failure carriers over ambient exception-driven control flow where
  practical
- composition of small transforms over long controller procedures

constraints.statement: Must prefer immutable carriers, closed typing, single ingress admission, explicit returns, practical explicit failure carriers and small-transform composition over shared mutable objects, open protocols, hidden mutation, ambient exception flow and long controllers. Must avoid giant mutable workspaces, orchestration owning semantic law, hidden global/registry/service coupling, typed envelopes over open truth, dynamic mutation at semantic center, helpers combining meaning decisions with writes, and proxy interfaces preserving old authority behind partial new design.

conditions: An exact boundary claims functional bias, pure transforms, immutable carriers, single-owner truth or low coupling.
exceptions: Immutable Carrier Rule's justified-mutation cases and adopted language expressive limits remain applicable.

grounding.quote:
Effect boundaries remain
typed and do not erase carrier truth into open objects. These policies retain the
Immutable Carrier Rule's justified-mutation cases and the adopted language's
expressive limits.

constraints.statement: Kernel is pure for identical admitted inputs. Time, randomness, UUID minting, environment/process/filesystem/network reads and registries belong to declared ingress/effect boundaries, with explicit identity-creation owner. Reject invalid/incomplete truth at ingress; local transforms use admitted carriers without reparsing/reloading locally assembled truth. Defaults are explicit, ratified and carrier-owned. Each function has one clear owner/responsibility; admission, semantics and effects cannot be mixed in convenience helpers. Algebra depends on carrier contracts, admission on validation, not runtime shells or orchestration; package/bootstrap/controller/adapter/runtime-shell layers stay below semantic center. Effect boundaries remain typed and preserve carrier truth.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced justified-mutation cases are not supplied.

conditions: This method governs a Python boundary.
exceptions: Narrow Any/cast/type-ignore uses are permitted only under all conditions in python_foreign_boundary_latitude.

grounding.quote:
When this method governs a Python boundary, repo-authored Python must be fully
typed.

That means:

- every function, method, and callable surface has explicit parameter and return
  annotations
- semantic carriers are closed and typed
- repo-authored tests, scripts, and support code are typed too; they do not get
  a lower bar than production code

constraints.statement: All repo-authored functions/methods/callables, including tests/scripts/support, require explicit parameter/return annotations and closed typed semantic carriers. Untyped def, implicit Any, semantic dict[str, Any]/Mapping[str, Any]/object and unchecked JSON passed across layers through .get chains do not count; semantic-center dict[str, Any] is design debt. Use closed forms such as dataclass/TypedDict/Protocol/Literal/Enum; validate dynamic input and narrow before transforms; Any stays at foreign ingress and collapses immediately. Run a strict static pass such as mypy --strict or equivalent; a boundary that cannot pass cleanly is not implementation-conformant.

conditions: Ontology-first profile applies to a new or materially changed active semantic boundary.
exceptions: A realization_refactor wholly within accepted boundary may cite existing Ontology/design and prove no ontology delta without reauthoring/reaccepting unchanged evidence.

grounding.quote:
Every new or materially changed active semantic boundary must derive its
semantic model from one accepted **Ontology**. Before a new or changed entity,
function, authority, effect, Prime-conformant carrier, module boundary, public
operation, or schema is promoted, the affected boundary must first produce a
candidate Ontology slice and carry it through the acceptance sequence below.

constraints.statement: Derive semantic model from one accepted Ontology; before promotion of changed/new entity, function, authority, effect, Prime-conformant carrier, module boundary, public operation or schema, produce candidate slice through acceptance sequence. Ontology derives from constitutional sources without inventing Product meaning; implementation/tests derive from requirements plus accepted design and preserve it. Acceptance identifies constitutional sources, accepting design authority, stable element/relation identities and version/basis making staleness and affected projection set decidable. Repricing invalidates only affected relations/projections until reevaluated; code/tests/generated schemas/single implementer cannot self-ratify authority. Acceptance may share the three-view design pack/record, requiring no second document/ticket/ceremony. Semantic/structural change publishes affected delta and impact set only; unrelated work does not freeze on one changed digest.
constraints.uncertainty: Later acceptance-sequence details and three-view gate are not fully supplied.

conditions: Sequencing work on a governed boundary.
exceptions: A disposable spike may supply evidence across unresolved decisions without becoming selected design.

grounding.quote:
- **co-evolution** is lawful only when `decision_complete(B)` holds. Design
  still owns the structural `HOW`, but design, implementation, and tests may
  evolve together and reconcile before promotion or closure;
- **design-gated** sequencing is required when implementation would otherwise
  establish an unresolved or contradictory relation, or choose between
  materially non-equivalent networks, with durable consequences for future
  change. The affected design decision must be accepted before retained
  implementation establishes it. A disposable spike may supply evidence
  without becoming the selected design.

constraints.statement: Neither mode is globally default. Co-evolution requires decision completeness and reconciles design/implementation/tests before promotion/closure while design owns HOW. Design gate is required before retained implementation establishes unresolved/contradictory relations or selects materially nonequivalent networks with durable consequences. Proportionality selects material relations and smallest causally closed affected gate; decision completeness tests admissibility. Reduced downstream code/runtime/test/review/reconciliation space is counterfactual contraction evidence, not an independent gate reason. Prior gate is warranted when ambiguity contraction justifies reasoning load; absent divergent architecture a separate gate adds no disambiguation. Bidirectional design/implementation is evidence only: code may expose counterexamples/ambiguity, not choose missing meaning, rewrite upstream truth or retroactively ratify decisions. Record selected relation/basis in existing carrier. Hidden ambiguity switches affected set to gated mode without invalidating unrelated work; repairs do not establish acceptance. Repeated/cross-cutting surprises enter Universal Intake Triage. Only diagnosis of underconstrained design with sufficient requirements requires bounded design_reframe; retained affected code stays provisional until acceptance. Surprise alone does not establish design cause; retain alternatives and select upstream change/further observation before treating design gate as sufficient.
constraints.uncertainty: Universal Intake Triage's full diagnosis procedure is external.

conditions: Decision completeness or promotion is claimed.

grounding.quote:
The boundary is underconstrained whenever `decision_complete(B)` is false,
including when implementation must introduce a new material semantic decision,
projections contradict one another, or two materially non-equivalent networks
remain admissible. Local algorithm and layout choices may remain open only when
every admitted choice is semantically equivalent under the accepted network.
Contradictory projections make the design unsatisfiable and block promotion.

Decision completeness does not require another document. The constraint
network may be expressed through the existing Ontology, algebra, module mapping,
and views when those surfaces jointly carry the complete relation.

constraints.statement: Ontology, Prime contraction, IACS, design, domain/sequence/state views, contracts, modules, implementation and tests project one M(B) network. Their presence, headings, plausibility or mechanical validity do not prove decision completeness. A false decision_complete predicate means underconstrained, including missing implementation-made semantic decisions, contradictory projections or nonequivalent admitted networks. Contradictions make design unsatisfiable and block promotion. Algorithm/layout choices remain open only when all admitted choices are semantically equivalent. Existing Ontology/algebra/mapping/views may jointly express network; no extra document is required.

conditions: A proposed action is inside M(B), under the applicable selected/adopted design relations.
exceptions: A single parent is sufficient only where actual governing structure is hierarchical.

grounding.quote:
Evaluate preservation against every affected governing frame and update only
affected subordinate projections. Changing an accepted governing relation
requires re-entry at that relation before acceptance. Open a subordinate frame
only for a material distinction unresolved at the governing altitude; neither
a closure algorithm nor recursive documentation of irrelevant descendants is
required. A locally valid action that violates or silently reinterprets an
affected governing invariant fails this obligation. Duplication follows
[UP-018's action classification and explicit disposition](#invariant-reconstruction-sufficiency-stdo-up-018);
an undisposed duplicate cannot establish preservation.

constraints.statement: Contract application/composition binding declares accepted governing frames, bounded affected relations, inherited invariants, crossing authority/composition seams and subordinate frames for unresolved material distinctions. Governance may be a network of lifecycle/consistency/admission/runtime/sibling consumers; seam closure needs causally relevant far-side relation or evidenced independence. Preserve every affected governing frame; update only affected subordinate projections; changing governing relation re-enters there before acceptance. Open subframes only for material unresolved distinctions; no mandated closure algorithm or irrelevant recursive documentation. Local validity cannot excuse violated/reinterpreted invariants; undisposed duplicates cannot establish preservation. Discovered verbs/screens/endpoints/commands/tickets/use cases are behavior evidence, not direct public-operation/carrier/module/function identities: derive through Ontology. Required order: constitutional functionality -> candidate Ontology -> logical completeness -> whole-family Prime contraction -> accepted Ontology -> IACS -> target design/domain-sequence-state views -> public contracts/adapters -> implementation/tests.
constraints.uncertainty: UP-018 action classes/disposition and shared support contract are not supplied in full.

conditions: Design acceptance is claimed under native constructability.

grounding.quote:
A semantically coherent design is not acceptable when its selected substrate
cannot natively construct the required identities, relationships, transitions,
authority boundaries, effects, lifecycle, composition, publication, and
retirement behavior.

A missing substrate capability remains an explicit design gap or triggers
lawful re-entry. It must not be hidden behind a reference bridge, adapter,
filesystem runner, test double, or promised future feature. This is a
constructability obligation, not a prescribed implementation; the consumer
chooses the substrate and evidence mechanism.

constraints.statement: Semantic coherence cannot establish acceptability when selected substrate cannot natively realize required identities, relationships, transitions, authority, effects, lifecycle, composition, publication and retirement. Missing capability stays explicit gap or triggers lawful re-entry; bridges/adapters/filesystem runners/test doubles/future promises cannot conceal it. Consumer chooses substrate and evidence mechanism; no implementation is prescribed.

conditions: Before constructing a material algorithm/common mechanic/generic capability, selecting a material dependency, or retaining a newly exposed material generic subproblem.
exceptions: No package survey/ledger is required for a trivial helper incapable of materially affecting authority, Product behavior, lifecycle cost or accepted design network.

grounding.quote:
Candidate discovery is bounded, reproducible, and explicitly non-exhaustive.
For every candidate category, the evidence record declares the sources or
collections searched, cutoff time and relevant version basis, applicability and
inclusion criteria, material exclusions, predecessor or incumbent status,
discovered candidates, and residual unknowns; a category not searched records
`not_applicable` or a named gap with its reason. Discovery closes only for that
declared basis and cutoff. A discovery gap that could materially alter the
frontier prevents selection; an immaterial residual records why it cannot change
the current decision. A later candidate that satisfies the applicability
criteria and could materially alter the lawful frontier invalidates the affected
selection evidence and re-enters this relation.

constraints.statement: Perform proportional selection first; describe capability without Product/domain/module/vendor/file/incumbent labels, separating irreducible semantic/authority roles with owner, kind, subject, scope, basis, lifecycle/refusal invariants from generic supporting mechanics. Factoring concerns roles, not authorship. For every candidate category record searched collections, cutoff/version basis, applicability/inclusion, exclusions, incumbent/predecessor status, candidates and residuals; unsearched category needs not_applicable or reasoned gap. Closure is only on that basis/cutoff. A potentially frontier-changing discovery gap prevents selection; immaterial residual explains why decision cannot change. Later applicable frontier-changing candidate invalidates affected evidence and re-enters. Stay inside Product and admitted migration strategy; do not choose bounded evolution versus fundamental readoption or override Spec presumption. Predecessor may constrain migration candidate set; discovery may start with incumbent but selection gives no source-order/familiarity/sunk-cost/local-code/dependency-count preference. Compare compositions, not just packages. Newly exposed material generic subproblems recursively re-enter before retained implementation; prior selection differs from later recurrence review.
constraints.uncertainty: External migration-strategy presumption and recurrence-review law are not fully supplied.

conditions: Comparing material candidates admitted to the bounded population.
exceptions: A dominated candidate can become selectable only when new evidence or another material dimension invalidates the dominance relation.

grounding.quote:
One lawful candidate composition **dominates** another on the current basis
only when every material decision dimension is comparable or evidenced as
non-discriminating between them, it is no worse on every comparable dimension,
and it is strictly better on at least one. A material unknown that could reverse
the relation prevents dominance and remains a gap. A dominated candidate cannot
be selected unless new evidence or another material dimension invalidates the
dominance relation. Therefore a local rebuild of generic mechanics is
inadmissible when an existing lawful foundation composition dominates it.
Unused feature breadth alone does not establish dominance and may itself add
lifecycle cost.

constraints.statement: Ledger/equivalent compares all decision-material dimensions, including functional/native fit; semantic/operation-authority leakage; adapter/integration/migration/deletion/future-code cost; license/maintenance/security/upgrade/supply chain; package/runtime/startup/storage/operation cost; determinism/concurrency/failure/recovery/reconstruction/replay; proof burden; exit/replacement/reversibility. Hard authority, Product-contract, safety, security, licensing or native-construction failure eliminates. Unknown stays unknown, never favorable score; universal scalar is unnecessary. Dominance requires every material dimension comparable or evidenced nondiscriminating, no worse on every comparable dimension, strictly better on at least one; potentially reversing unknown prevents it. Dominated local rebuilding is inadmissible subject to exception. Unused features alone do not dominate and may add cost. Existing tradeoff owner may choose lawful undominated composition only through exact Product/basis priorities and risk tolerance with recorded frontier resolution; unresolved priorities leave gap. No automatic minimum dependencies/edit/lines or maximum features. Rejected material candidates record decisive evidence/falsifier; unsupported preference is not closure. Reuse grants no automatic authority; assigned authority roles must preserve owner/kind/subject/scope/basis/lifecycle/refusal invariants, and capability/provenance/authorship cannot widen/remint roles. Ownership remains with relation, including reused implementations; local generic code must win same comparison and is not default.

conditions: Ontology profile applies to entities within the active boundary.
exceptions: Subordinate payloads/value objects inherit owner's lifecycle and authority and need no peer row unless Promotion Test is passed.

grounding.quote:
Every cell must identify a lawful function, declare `not_applicable` with a
reason, or name a `Gap:` / `Unanswered:` item and owner. Silence is not
logical-completeness evidence.

constraints.statement: Enumerate entities, identities, relations, cardinalities, invariants, lifecycle states and authority owners. Provide lifecycle matrix or closed equivalent for each identity-bearing entity/independently governed value family subject to subordinate exception. Cells require lawful function, reasoned not_applicable, or named Gap:/Unanswered: with owner; silence is not evidence. Columns ask completeness, not mutable CRUD: creation may be declaration/construction/admission/materialization; reads should normally project typed authoritative truth; updates should normally be admitted transitions/new versions; deletion should normally retire/revoke/decommission/supersede where identity/history must persist. Domain lifecycle does not substitute for operational module lifecycle.
constraints.uncertainty: Full Promotion Test and operational lifecycle section 6C are outside supplied source.

conditions: An Ontology function/lifecycle transition crosses semantic, authority, admission, effect, persistence or public boundary.
exceptions: Pure subordinate helpers inherit owner function's authority envelope and need no peer row unless crossing such a boundary.
One owner may fill multiple roles only with explicit governing authority.

grounding.quote:
One owner may lawfully occupy more than one role only when the governing
authority explicitly says so. Role coincidence must not be inferred from
implementation convenience.

Pure subordinate helpers inherit the authority envelope of their owning
Ontology function and do not require peer authority rows unless they cross one
of those boundaries.

constraints.statement: Provide authority matrix/closed equivalent; distinguish actor from authority, capability from admitted current-basis authority, proposal from evaluation/verification/admission/execution/projection/retirement, attribution from permission, and domain meaning owner from runtime-effect owner. Do not infer coincident roles from convenience. Apply external authority law to composition inputs/constituents/projections/current basis; matrix binds existing admitted grants including downstream witness. Delegation/elevation/transfer/retirement authority additionally needs named typed transition and owning admission boundary.

conditions: Every consequential entity-transition domain and material admission relation under the selected law.
exceptions: Unsupported composite/nested forms may be not_applicable only if accepted domain/design excludes the form and no weaker/competing path exists.

grounding.quote:
This obligation is false if a field, owner, or supported boundary is missing or
invented downstream; basis continuity, partial-failure boundary coverage or its
dominance/equivalence proof, or reconstruction is left to implementation
inference; or non-applicability is established only by a parser, helper, or
manufactured refusal.

constraints.statement: Accepted design declares each owner/supported admission boundary; exact admission-valid basis and predecessor/currentness continuity through admission plus equal/coherent composite multi-owner basis; complete enclosing relation, participant identities/equality joins; refusal/effect boundaries; complete semantic commit unit/decomposability and every materially distinct post-validation commit/publication boundary exposing a subset, or named representative-observation dominance/equivalence proof covering whole partial-failure surface; reconstruction/supported direct-composite-nested forms; and competing-path disposition. SPEC UP-021 solely owns admission/standing-test semantics; qualification is per owner/supported boundary. Missing or downstream-invented fields/owners/boundaries, inferred basis continuity/partial-failure coverage/proof/reconstruction, or parser/helper/manufactured-refusal nonapplicability makes this obligation false.
constraints.uncertainty: UP-021 admission and standing-test definitions are absent.

exceptions: Disjoint identities/scopes are not counterexamples to singularity.
Multiple actors/stages/implementations are lawful constituents or disjoint instances with declared cardinality/adjudication.
Equivalent paths need not be deleted if explicitly related as constituent, replica, replacement or deliberately independent realization.

grounding.quote:
- two materially non-equivalent admission relations remain reachable for the
  same governed transition domain on the same entity identity, authority scope,
  and predecessor basis — disjoint scopes or identities are not a
  counterexample;
- a materially equivalent competing implementation remains reachable without
  being identified as a constituent, replica, replacement, or deliberately
  independent realization; or
- a projection-triggered reaction uses its own reconstructive state as
  self-authenticating admission evidence.

constraints.statement: Singularity attaches to complete decision relation, not one actor/callable/component; declared relations may require one actor, multiple signatures, quorum, human step-up, proxy delegation or jurisdictional partition. Competing-path disposition need not delete equivalent paths, but superseded responsibility retention requires distinct supported purpose under external Core Interface Migration Rule, not label/test alone. Projection can propose transformation but grants no admission authority; consequential result re-enters governing relation against explicit predecessor, never self-authenticating reconstructed state. Law is false when two materially nonequivalent paths remain reachable on same transition/entity/scope/predecessor, equivalent reachable implementations lack explicit relationship, or projector reactions self-authenticate. Stated exceptions retain lawful multiplicity.
constraints.uncertainty: Full external Core Interface Migration Rule is not supplied.

conditions: Using the admission contract for a declared candidate and predecessor on a scoped entity.

grounding.quote:
A shape-correct projector candidate therefore requires authentic
current-predecessor support and the actual grant at this gate; those facts
alone do not establish the remaining admission conditions. Unresolved seams
use UP-017's declared affected set under the shared support condition. Basis
advancement before semantic commit prevents the effect and requires UP-021
current-basis re-entry. This is the existing admission assessment, not an
additional validation pass.

constraints.statement: Bind authoritative admission basis, complete relation/commit unit, required support, admitter grant and supported durable-result/other outcome under Contract application/admission specialization; these are semantic bindings, not new carrier. Method owns design completeness; UP-021 owns admission/standing tests, reason-sensitive mapping, missing/stale/incompatible/unusable basis, trust-boundary validation and separate assessment/authorized-decision/observed-commit predicates. Predecessor continuity/currentness/admitter authority are material joins. Preserve qualified outcome and performance/effects including nonperformance, partial publication and unknown effects. Candidate shape is different predicate. Shape-correct projector still needs authentic current-predecessor support and actual grant, insufficient alone for all admission conditions. Unresolved seams use UP-017 affected set. Basis advancement before semantic commit prevents effect and requires current-basis re-entry in existing assessment, not another validation pass.
constraints.uncertainty: UP-021's exact reason-sensitive map and standing tests cannot be reconstructed from the supplied references.

conditions: The adopted boundary derives functions; higher-order requirements apply where such behavior exists.
exceptions: Iterative discovery of composition/effects/implementation is allowed only when co_evolution_admissible(B); otherwise disposable spikes alone may supply preacceptance evidence across affected unresolved, contradictory or materially nonequivalent relations.
constraints.statement: Derive smallest lifecycle-complete parameterized families; differences only in entity/projection/transition kind, policy or subordinate payload should normally be typed parameters/closed variants rather than peers. Every minimum evidence row must be admitted-atomic-derived, declared-composition-derived, deferred with owner/re-entry, excluded by current Product authority, or named unresolved gap. Higher-order boundaries name composition/effect algebra and applicable identity, closure, associativity, cardinality, effect and authority-conservation laws explicitly. No mandatory monadic/category vocabulary; ODD may bind GTL/ABG, others explicit alternatives. Every retained result reconciles into accepted design before promotion/closure; no private helper, loop, adapter or endpoint becomes undeclared constructor.

conditions: Prime acceptance/conformance is claimed under the adopted profile.
exceptions: Out-of-domain cases may justify proposing a new candidate atom for design admission.

grounding.quote:
Every accepted Prime atom declares the admitted domain over which its law
holds. Within that domain it governs every admitted instance. A later use case
composes or parameterizes the atom; it does not fork, shadow, specialize, or
reinterpret the atom locally. An out-of-domain case may justify proposing
another candidate atom for design admission. An in-domain counterexample
falsifies the shared atom and re-enters at that atom's design boundary rather
than authorizing a feature-local replacement.

An atom without a declared admitted domain remains a candidate atom. It cannot
supply Prime acceptance or Prime-conformance to a realization projection.

constraints.statement: One atom may map to several units and one unit to several atoms with explicit mapping and no rival meaning/authority. Atomic functions are not proven Prime before whole-family contraction. Each accepted atom declares domain and governs every admitted instance therein; later use cases compose/parameterize, never locally fork/shadow/specialize/reinterpret. In-domain counterexample falsifies shared atom and re-enters its design boundary, not feature-local replacement. No declared domain means candidate only, incapable of granting Prime acceptance/conformance.

conditions: Before promotion under whole-family Prime review.

grounding.quote:
Prime review evaluates the complete candidate semantic-atom family and every
proposed realization projection, not only functions, carriers, or each atom in
isolation. The family includes every proposed identity, authority transition,
lifecycle relation, topology, function, composition law, effect, and closure
law. A function-and-carrier-only pass does not establish whole-family Prime.

constraints.statement: Review complete identity/authority-transition/lifecycle/topology/function/composition/effect/closure family and every realization projection, not isolated atoms or functions/carriers alone. Ask whether operations are parameters of one function, commands transitions of one entity, reads projections of one truth, implementations instances of higher-order function; whether independent identity/authority/effect/lifecycle/reuse/public-pattern-match semantics are introduced; whether every kind entered contraction; every unit maps to accepted atoms; and any projection duplicates/reinterprets/introduces meaning or authority. Plausible separate functions are not Prime if one parameterized template with closed variants preserves meaning/authority. Contract visible recurrence during design; postimplementation recurrence review is no substitute.

conditions: A material semantic boundary undergoes Prime contraction.
exceptions: Work within accepted boundary cites existing Prime basis rather than recreating it.

grounding.quote:
Contraction must preserve root authority and every retained semantic relation.
Reducing files, functions, operations, or authoring surfaces cannot compensate
for introducing another authority source or truth path. Prime evidence states
the complete candidate semantic-atom family; each atom's stable identity,
irreducible relation, admitted domain, and falsification condition; the
whole-family contraction relation; retained meaning and authority before and
after contraction; accepted loss; and the explicit total mapping from every
proposed realization projection to its accepted atom or atoms. Work inside an
accepted boundary cites the existing Prime basis rather than recreating it.

constraints.statement: Contract each candidate atom and then complete resulting family. Local irreducibility/conformance does not prove global Prime where identity/authority/function/lifecycle/topology/effect/projection meaning duplicates. Preserve root authority and every retained relation; fewer files/functions/operations/surfaces cannot compensate rival truth/authority. Evidence includes full candidate family; each stable atom identity, irreducible relation, domain and falsifier; whole-family contraction; before/after meaning/authority; accepted loss; and total projection-to-accepted-atoms mapping.

conditions: A design projection is made under the adopted Ontology profile.
exceptions: Intentional omission/flattening requires declared accepted loss and failure condition.
Implementation branches/test expectations need not be individually enumerated in Ontology when traceable through requirements plus accepted design.

grounding.quote:
The binding names its Ontology source and the laws preserved. Intentional
omission or flattening declares accepted loss and a failure condition. Target
design may add structural HOW, but cannot originate rival semantic meaning.
A public operation, message, transition, carrier or effect untraceable through
accepted design to the Ontology cannot enter the active line. Implementation
branches and test expectations trace to requirements plus accepted design;
they preserve the Ontology without needing individual enumeration in it.

constraints.statement: Apply Faithful projection from named accepted Ontology preserving identity, relationship, lifecycle, authority, function and effect laws. Targets include domain/class, sequence/state views; authority/effect matrices; IACS; APIs/operation registers/SDK/CLI; schemas/codecs/manifests/catalogs; architecture/modules; and implementation/test/proof through accepted design and requirements. Name source/laws; target design may add HOW but no rival meaning. Untraceable public operation/message/transition/carrier/effect cannot enter active line.

conditions: Prime profile applies to top-level realization units.

grounding.quote:
A top-level realization unit is **Prime-conformant** only when it projects one
or more accepted Prime atoms without introducing, duplicating, or
reinterpreting semantic authority. A topological or effect boundary must first
be derived and accepted as a Prime atom. Source-code size and one-to-one
correspondence with an atom are immaterial.

constraints.statement: Derive atoms from logically complete candidate Ontology before top-level units; whole-family Prime supports Ontology acceptance. Design/IACS/modules/functions/schemas/tests project accepted atoms, not originate meaning. Prime-conformance applies to functions/classes/carrier types/top-level schemas/modules; typed closure alone does not justify new top-level type. Unit must project accepted atoms without introducing/duplicating/reinterpreting authority; topological/effect boundaries first require accepted atoms, regardless of code size or one-to-one mapping. Typical lawful new boundaries are admitted graph topology/branch, typed carrier transform, effect, validation/admission or projection. Units solely shortening calls, aggregating unrelated convenience, renaming old interfaces, wrapping/shuttling, hiding mutation/fallback/orchestration, naming payload variations lacking authority, publishing internal detail without irreducibility, mirroring slight field variation or multiplying types for typing discomfort are nonconformant. Prefer composition, existing lawful functions and fewer sharper boundaries/families. Aim is preventing fragmentation/helper sprawl, not minimum lines.

conditions: Reviewing decomposition or Prime contraction.

grounding.quote:
Review cuts, realization units, runtime modules, and work items are distinct
boundaries. They may relate many-to-one or one-to-many and must not be forced
into one-to-one decomposition for administrative convenience.

Prime review accounts for governance cost as well as implementation count.
Contraction is not successful when it increases authority centers, maintained
truth surfaces, acceptance boundaries, dependency cycles, manually reconciled
projections, or review burden. Evidence remains proportional to semantic
change and risk; this rule does not require one artifact or review per concern.
